searchText: Hey CL client devs. What do we think about this PR? I think it's a nice config simplification, but I would like to hear from clients before merging it. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4814 anything which contravenes that PR is broadly not a valid configuration anyway so it's only removing false degrees of freedom
